title: FACAD: Festival-Aware Calendar-Adjusted anomaly Detection for Indian network traffic — code, derived data and results
description: Code, derived datasets and result tables for the article 'Festival-Aware Anomaly Detection for Indian Network Traffic: Calendar-Adjusted Residuals, Regional Pooling and Context-Conditional Thresholds' (submitted to Applied Intelligence). Experiment 1: Google mobility data for 36 Indian states (2020–22). Experiment 2: Cloudflare Radar hourly state traffic shares, 17–24 October 2026 (CC BY-NC 4.0). Includes leave-one-state-out transfer and sensitivity analyses.
